summary: The SME invoice-to-books engine lives on the platform snapshot (/home/user/ro/platform/src). It is a synchronous engine on better-sqlite3 (`DB = Database.Database` in src/db/open.ts). One ledger file holds the AP tables (schema.sql) and an append-only, hash-chained double-entry ledger (ledger.sql). An invoice moves through these steps: `ingestDocument` (src/ap/inbox.ts) stores the PDF by its sha256, reads it with Claude (Haiku classifies, Sonnet reads, Opus writes the review note) or with a parser, and runs the checks (`evaluate`). The accrual is booked to a sink and the invoice gets a status. Then `payApInvoice` (src/ap/pay.ts) files a proposal for a passkey approval. `execute` (src/executors/index.ts) pays through Airwallex. `syncPayments` marks the invoice paid and pushes the payment entries. `syncLedger` (src/ledger/feed.ts) posts the accrual, payment, fee and FX entries into `ledger_entries`/`ledger_lines`. `syncVault` (src/vault/build.ts) files the original PDF, a pdfkit payment receipt, and the month, VAT and year reports into a fixed Dutch folder tree with a per-year index.json. Report math is already pure: the `*From(lines)` functions in src/ledger/reports.ts, which cloud/src/read.ts reuses on D1. Most other code needs a synchronous better-sqlite3-style handle. The blockers for Workers are better-sqlite3 itself, `pdfText` (node:worker_threads + node:zlib + unpdf), node:fs document storage and pdfkit. The ERP connectors (Exact, Business Central, Odoo, Moneybird) are built and tested against the vendors' documented request shapes only; nothing has been sent to a live ERP. T:0 is live in its sandbox: 95 entries were posted on 10 Nov. The e2e world is three fictional Dutch companies with four invoices in total; the live run on 10 Nov paid 1 of 4 invoices to PAID.

key_files.role: `openDb(path)`: opens a better-sqlite3 file (WAL, busy_timeout, foreign_keys), runs schema.sql + ledger.sql + `migrate`. Exports `type DB = Database.Database`.

AP tables: `ap_documents`, `ap_scan_readings`, `ap_invoices`, `ap_duplicate_clearances`, `payee_adds`, `ap_sink_events`, plus `beneficiaries`, `proposals`, `approvals`, `transfers`, `fx_quotes`, `fx_conversions`, `platform_fees`, `audit_log`, `settings`.

`ledger_entries` (hash chain: prev_hash/entry_hash, source_key UNIQUE, reverses), `ledger_lines` (cents, currency, cost_centre, vat_code, party, due_date, doc_ref), `ledger_locks`, `stock_items`, `stock_moves`. Triggers make all of them append-only.
`ingestDocument`, `ingestEmail`, `recheck`, `clearPossibleDuplicate`, private `book` and `glFor`. This is the single entry point for upload, folder, e-mail and API.

`evaluate(db, reading, text, ctx)` returns findings; `statusOf`. Finding codes: missing_fields, no_text, iban_invalid, no_bank_details, bank_details_invalid, sum_mismatch, credit_note, ambiguous_total, duplicate, possible_duplicate, rejected_before, possible_fraud, new_supplier, payee_blocked, account_currency, currency_not_paid, unusual_amount, overdue.

`payApInvoice` (passes to `proposeSupplierPayment` or `proposeInvoicePayment`), `syncPayments` (waiting_cfo to paid/rejected/ready, then pushes accrual and payment), `rejectApInvoice`, `transferReason`.

`accrualEntries`, `paymentEntries` (includes FX through 1590, fee 6800, platform fee), `reversalEntries`, `bookable`, `apJournal`, `BookkeepingSink`, `CsvFileSink`, `payablesSink` (KIT11_AP_DIR/journal.csv), `pushOnce` (deduplicated via `ap_sink_events`).
`postEntry`, `postClosingEntry`, `reverseEntry`, `lockMonth`, `closedThrough`, `postingDay`, `ledgerRows`, `verifyLedger`, `verifyLedgerRows`, `LedgerRefused`.

`syncLedger(db, now)`: reconciles `journal()` (accounting/gl.ts) plus AP accruals into the stored ledger. Each event posts once by source_key; when its source changes it is reversed and reposted under @vN.
`journal(db)`: derives money movements from sales, cards, airi_purchases, transfers (pays off 2100 when accrued), platform_fees, fx_conversions (1590), sweeps, clearing. `accruedInboxKeys`.

`postedLines`, `trialBalance`/`trialFrom`, `profitAndLoss`/`profitAndLossFrom`, `balanceSheet`/`balanceSheetFrom`, `cashByCurrency`, `ageing`/`ageingFrom`, `vatOverview`/`vatOverviewFrom`, `quarterRange`. The *From variants are pure.
`closeMonth`, `closeYear` (closing entry to 3100, locks 12 months).
Generic `purchaseInvoice`, `salesInvoice`, `settleOpenItem`, `openAmount`. Only stock.ts calls them; the AP flow does not.
`syncVault(db, sink, opts)` (plan, then create-only plus a per-year index.json), `verifyVault`, `fileIntoLocalVault` (KIT11_VAULT, KIT11_VAULT_DIR).
Folder tree: `invoicePath`, `paymentPath`, `monthReportPath`, `vatPath`, `yearReportPath`, `suppliersPath`, `yearIndexPath`, `correctionName`, `withId`, `safeSegment`.
pdfkit renderers: `receiptPdf`, `monthReportPdf`, `vatPdf`, `yearReportPdf`, `suppliersPdf`. `type Lang = "nl" | "en"`; uses the standard Helvetica fonts.
`VaultSink` interface (stat/create/readIndex/writeIndex/read?), `LocalSink` (node:fs). Other sinks: gdrive.ts `GoogleDriveSink`, onedrive.ts `OneDriveSink` (fetch-based).
`proposeSupplierPayment` (pays in the invoice currency; buys the shortfall on a locked quote from `fundingCurrency`), `payoutBeneficiary`, `freeCents`, `floorCents`, `feeReserveFor`.
Pure route table: `chooseRoute`, `validateDetails`, `routeLimitReason`, `payableCurrency`, `SWIFT_CURRENCIES`, `PAYOUT_COUNTRIES` (US, GB, CN, TR, NL, DE), `referenceProblem`, `MAX_REFERENCE`=140.

`execute(db, proposalId)` dispatches by kind: payee_add (`executePayeeAdd`), invoice_payment (`executeInvoicePayment`), supplier_payment (`executeSupplierPayment`), payment_batch (`executePaymentBatch`).
`syncAll`, `correct`, `resolve`, `syncStatus`, `ensureErpSchema` (`erp_sync` table). Sends in order vendors, invoices, payments, journals, resuming step by step.
`ledgerItems(db)`: maps beneficiaries, AP invoices, PAID transfers and GL journal lines to the canonical model (src/erp/model.ts).
`runPlatformE2E`, `runCompany`, `toPostings`, `pushToT0`, `withPayer`, `WaitingForAirwallexApproval`.
`WORLD`: 3 test companies and 4 Dutch invoices (`nlInvoice` template).
`vaultWorld({close})`: the shortest full in-process chain (ingest, pay, decide, execute, syncPayments, syncLedger, closeMonth) with FakeAirwallex and the parser. Best template for a demo world.
Proof that the reports run in a Worker: it imports the pure `*From` functions from ../../src/ledger/reports.js over D1 rows.

how_it_works:
Chain (platform snapshot):
1. Intake: `ingestDocument(db, deps: InboxDeps{dir, reader: Asker, now?, sink?}, doc)` in src/ap/inbox.ts. A .eml file goes to `ingestEmail`, which calls `parseEml` (src/ap/eml.ts) and handles up to 20 PDF attachments. A JPEG/PNG is converted with `imageInfo` and then `imageToPdf` (pdfkit, src/ap/scan.ts). The sha256 is computed. A sha already in `ap_documents` returns duplicate_document. Otherwise the file is written read-only to `<dir>/docs/<sha>.pdf`.
2. Text: `pdfText` (src/ap/pdfText.ts: unpdf inside a node:worker_threads Worker, with a decode budget via node:zlib). If the PDF has no text layer, `scanRefusal` decides whether a scan reading is allowed, and `readScan` reads it twice through `reader.askPdf`, which writes `ap_scan_readings`.
3. Insert into `ap_documents`. `classifyDocument` (Haiku; src/ap/classify.ts) labels the document. For an invoice, credit note or reminder, `readDocument` (Sonnet; src/ap/read.ts) reads it and `readingCheck` verifies that reading; otherwise `parseApFallback` (src/ap/reading.ts) parses it.
4. `evaluate` (src/ap/checks.ts). This includes the duplicate check through `handledInLedger` (src/ap/ledgerKey.ts) and the fraud check through `assessAgainst` (src/policy/fraudCore.ts) against `suppliersOnFile`. `statusOf` gives blocked, needs_review, needs_vendor or ready. `glFor` picks the expense account. Insert into `ap_invoices`, with `audit(...'ap.received')` into `audit_log`. When needed, `writeReviewNote` (Opus; src/ap/review.ts) runs. Then `book`, which calls `pushOnce(sink,'accrual', accrualEntries(inv))`; this pushes to the sink and writes `ap_sink_events`.
5. New supplier: `requestPayeeAddForInvoice`, then `recordPayeeAddVerification` (a person), then `proposePayeeAdd` (the CFO passkey), then `executePayeeAdd` (Airwallex beneficiary, then `recheck`), all in src/ap/vendors.ts. Tables: `payee_adds`, `beneficiaries`, `proposals`.
6. Pay: `payApInvoice` (or `payApInvoices` for a batch, src/ap/batchPay.ts). EUR to a Kit 11 payee goes through `proposeInvoicePayment` (src/agents/euroBill.ts); anything else goes through `proposeSupplierPayment` (src/payouts/plan.ts). Status becomes waiting_cfo; the proposal's explanation is the Opus note.
7. Approval: the passkey is checked in src/passkey/process.ts, then `decide` (src/policy/approvals.ts) writes `approvals`.
8. Execute: `execute` (src/executors/index.ts) calls `executeInvoicePayment` or `executeSupplierPayment` (`fx_quotes`, `fx_conversions`, `transfers`, `platform_fees`, holds, money_steps).
9. `syncPayments` (src/ap/pay.ts) calls `followPayouts` (src/payouts/follow.ts), then `expireDue`. A PAID transfer sets the invoice to paid, then `pushOnce` accrual and `pushOnce` payment with `paymentEntries`. On REJECTED, `reversalEntries` is pushed.
10. Stored ledger: `syncLedger(db)` (src/ledger/feed.ts) takes `journal(db)` plus `openingLines` plus the AP accruals and posts them with `postEntry`, or `reverseEntry` when a source changed. Callers: `npm run ledger -- sync` and `src/cloudsync/client.ts`.
11. Vault: `syncVault(db, sink)`, or `fileIntoLocalVault` after the payables and ledger CLIs. It files the original PDF, `receiptPdf` for each paid invoice, the month report for each closed month, VAT for closed quarters and the year report.

DB driver: better-sqlite3 13.0.3, fully synchronous. It uses `db.prepare().get/all/run`, `db.transaction(fn).immediate()` and `db.pragma`.

There are two booking paths: (a) the `BookkeepingSink` CSV journal (ApEntry) and (b) the stored ledger (`ledger_entries`). Both are built from the same `accrualEntries`. The payment side of (b) comes from gl.ts `journal()`, not from `paymentEntries`.

answers.question: 1) Full chain invoice file to paid, booked, archived; DB driver; tables
answers.answer: Order: `ingestDocument` or `ingestEmail` (src/ap/inbox.ts, which uses `parseEml`, `imageInfo`/`imageToPdf`, `pdfText`, `scanRefusal`/`readScan`, `classifyDocument`, `readDocument` or `parseApFallback`, `evaluate`, `statusOf`, `glFor`, `writeReviewNote`, `book` → `pushOnce('accrual')`). If the supplier is new: `requestPayeeAddForInvoice`, then `recordPayeeAddVerification`, then `proposePayeeAdd`, then (after the passkey) `executePayeeAdd`, which calls `recheck` (src/ap/vendors.ts). Then `payApInvoice` (src/ap/pay.ts) or `payApInvoices` (src/ap/batchPay.ts), which go to `proposeSupplierPayment` (src/payouts/plan.ts) or `proposeInvoicePayment` (src/agents/euroBill.ts) and create a proposal. After the passkey (`processAssertion` in src/passkey/process.ts, then `decide` in src/policy/approvals.ts), `execute` (src/executors/index.ts) runs `executeSupplierPayment`, `executeInvoicePayment` or `executePaymentBatch`. Next comes `syncPayments` (`followPayouts`, `expireDue`, `setStatus('paid')`, `pushOnce` accrual and payment), then `syncLedger` (src/ledger/feed.ts: `postEntry`/`reverseEntry`), then `syncVault` (src/vault/build.ts). HTTP surface: `payablesApp(db, opts)` in src/servers/payables.ts. It serves POST /api/payables/documents, /invoices/:id/pay, /batch, /invoices/:id/reject, /accept-credit, /supplier-request, /suppliers/:addId/verify(-code), /suppliers/:addId/propose, /not-duplicate(-code), /sync, plus the GET exports journal.csv and invoices.csv. It listens on 127.0.0.1:4400 via `npm run payables`. Driver: better-sqlite3 (sync), opened through `openDb`. Tables: ap_documents, ap_scan_readings, ap_invoices, ap_duplicate_clearances, payee_adds, ap_sink_events, beneficiaries, proposals, approvals, batch_lines, transfers, fx_quotes, fx_conversions, platform_fees, payout_reservations/holds/money_steps (executors), audit_log, settings, ledger_entries, ledger_lines, ledger_locks. Files: <KIT11_AP_DIR>/docs/<sha>.pdf, journal.csv, and data/vault/**.

answers.question: 2) Ledger: tables, posting per event, reports, month lock, purity
answers.answer:
Tables are `ledger_entries`, `ledger_lines`, `ledger_locks`, `stock_items` and `stock_moves`, all append-only by trigger and hash-chained (`LEDGER_GENESIS`, `hashOf` = sha256(prev_hash + jcs(body))). Every entry must balance per currency (`checkLines`). Postings per event:
- Invoice received: `accrualEntries` (src/ap/books.ts) debits the expense (gl_account, net) and 1510 input VAT, and credits 2100 for the total. `syncLedger` posts this under source_key `ap-accrual|<id>` and sets vat_code P21/P9 when the tax matches 21% or 9% of net (`dutchVat`).
- Paid: gl.ts `journal()` source 'transfer' debits 2100 (when `accruedInboxKeys` contains the invoice) and credits the bank `bankAccountFor(currency)` (1200 EUR, 1201 USD, 1202 GBP, 1203 other). The fee goes to 6800 and the Purser platform fee to 6800.
- FX: source 'fx' moves sell bank → 1590 transit and 1590 → buy bank, one balanced entry per currency. There is no FX revaluation and no FX gain/loss account; reports stay per currency ('no revaluation into one reporting currency yet').
- Rejected: the CSV sink gets `reversalEntries`; the stored ledger reverses on its next `syncLedger`.
- Generic postings: `purchaseInvoice`, `salesInvoice` and `settleOpenItem` in src/ledger/documents.ts (only stock.ts uses them); `buyGoods` and `sellGoods` in stock.ts.
Reports (src/ledger/reports.ts): `trialBalance`, `profitAndLoss`, `balanceSheet`, `vatOverview` (Dutch rubrics 1a–5b; 'An overview, not a filing'), `ageing` (receivables/payables), `cashByCurrency`. `stockOnHand` is in stock.ts. The HTML page is `ledgerPage` (src/ledger/page.ts), served by `ledgerApp` (express, src/ledger/serve.ts).
Month lock: `lockMonth` / `closeMonth` / `closeYear` (src/ledger/close.ts). `postingDay` moves an entry dated in a closed month to the first day after `closedThrough`.
Purity: every posting function takes a better-sqlite3 handle and runs synchronous IMMEDIATE transactions, so none of them is pure. Reports come in two forms: `trialBalance(db)` etc. are thin wrappers over `postedLines(db)`, and `trialFrom(lines)`, `profitAndLossFrom`, `balanceSheetFrom`, `ageingFrom` and `vatOverviewFrom` are pure functions over `PostedLine[]` (already reused by cloud/src/read.ts). `verifyLedgerRows(rows)` is pure as well. CLI: `npm run ledger -- sync|trial|pnl|balance|vat --quarter 2026Q4|ageing payables|close --month 2026-11|export --csv|verify|serve`.

answers.question: 3) Vault: folder tree, document types, PDF library, Workers, sinks
answers.answer:
Tree (src/vault/layout.ts), fixed and in Dutch whatever the language:
- `<Company>/<YYYY>/<YYYY-Qn>/Inkoopfacturen/<Vendor>/<date> <invoice_no> <CUR> <total>.pdf`, with blocked invoices under `Inkoopfacturen/_Geblokkeerd/<Vendor>/`
- `<Company>/<YYYY>/<YYYY-Qn>/Betalingen/<date> <Vendor> <invoice_no>.pdf`
- `<Company>/<YYYY>/<YYYY-Qn>/Rapporten/<YYYY-MM> Maandrapport.pdf` and `.../Rapporten/<YYYY-Qn> Btw-overzicht.pdf`
- `<Company>/<YYYY>/<YYYY> Jaarrapport.pdf`, `<Company>/<YYYY>/Leveranciers <date>.pdf`, `<Company>/<YYYY>/index.json`
Corrections are added beside the original as ' (correctie N)'; nothing is overwritten.
VaultKind values: invoice (the original PDF bytes, re-hashed against doc_sha256), receipt, month, vat, year, suppliers.
PDF library: pdfkit 0.20.2 (`render` in src/vault/pdf.ts, standard Helvetica fonts, `PDF_STRINGS` nl/en). Whether it runs in Workers is unknown and untested. pdfkit's Node build loads its AFM font data from disk via fs, so it would likely need pdfkit's standalone/browser build or another library (e.g. pdf-lib). No Worker in the repo generates PDFs; cloud/ only ships pdf.js for viewing (`npm run cloud:pdfjs`) and an Inter font.
Sinks: `LocalSink` (node:fs, files mode 444, src/vault/sink.ts), `GoogleDriveSink` (fetch, KIT11_GDRIVE_TOKEN, KIT11_GDRIVE_FOLDER_ID), `OneDriveSink` (Graph, KIT11_GRAPH_TOKEN, KIT11_GRAPH_DRIVE_ID). The interface is async, so an R2 sink would be a small adapter. CLI: `npm run vault -- build [--dry-run] [--lang en]`, `sync --to local|gdrive|onedrive`, `verify`, `serve --port 4600`.

answers.question: 4) ERP connectors and T0 sync
answers.answer:
All four implement `ErpConnector` (src/erp/connector.ts): pullChartOfAccounts, pullVendors, findExisting, incomplete?, pushVendor, pushPurchaseInvoice, pushCreditNote, pushPayment, pushJournalEntry, pullPaymentStatus.
- `ExactConnector` (src/erp/exact.ts, OData v2, OAuth with a rotating refresh token in data/erp/exact.token.json via `exactTokens`/`fileTokenStore`): crm/Accounts + BankAccounts, purchaseentry/PurchaseEntries (type 30; credit note type 31), documents/Documents, financialtransaction/BankEntries, GeneralJournalEntries, cashflow/Payments.
- `BusinessCentralConnector` (API v2.0, Entra client credentials via `entraTokens`): vendors (bank account added by a person), purchaseInvoices + lines (posted only when the total matches), attachments, purchaseCreditMemos, vendorPayments (a person posts the journal), journals/journalLines.
- `OdooConnector` (XML-RPC through its own src/erp/xmlrpc.ts, Odoo 18): res.partner/res.partner.bank, account.move in_invoice/in_refund/entry, ir.attachment, account.payment. A person reconciles.
- `MoneybirdConnector` (REST v2, bearer token, `documents` scope, checked against the OpenAPI subset in test/fixtures/moneybird/openapi-subset.json).
Status (docs/erp.md, docs/moneybird.md): 'built and tested against the vendors' documented request and answer shapes only. Nothing has been sent to a live ERP yet.'
Runner: `syncAll` in src/erp/sync.ts writes the `erp_sync` table, records step progress, never posts twice, and handles needs_correction through `correct` (credit note plus the new version). Feed: `ledgerItems(db)` in src/erp/source.ts. CLI: `npm run erp -- list|status|sync --connector exact|bc|odoo|moneybird --dry-run|--live|pull|resolve|correct`. Registry: `liveConnector` and `dryRunConnector` (RecordingTransport plus EXAMPLE settings) in src/erp/registry.ts.
T:0: `T0_SANDBOX_MAP` (version 2, `T0_MAP_VERSION`) in src/config/t0Map.ts maps Purser account codes to T:0's shared sandbox chart. Client and logic live in src/accounting/t0.ts: `T0Client`, `buildEntries`, `pushBooks`, `compareReports`, `resolveAccounts`, `functionalCurrency`, `t0Posted`/`recordT0Posting` (table t0_postings). src/accounting/t0Sink.ts has `t0SinkOnce` and `t0SinkFor` (hooked into executors/index.ts). CLI: `npm run t0 -- accounts|push --rate USD=0.92 [--dry-run]|compare`. Status: 95 entries posted to the T:0 sandbox on 10 Nov and matched line by line (docs/t0.md, docs/runs/2026-11-10-t0-journal-sandbox.md). T:0 works from the books in src/accounting/books.ts (`books`, `doubleEntry`), not from ledger_entries.

answers.question: 5) Multi-currency payouts
answers.answer:
`proposeSupplierPayment` (src/payouts/plan.ts) pays in the invoice's own currency to the beneficiary that `payee_add` created. It uses `freeCents` (balance minus in-flight minus held minus batch reserve), `feeReserveFor(method)` and `floorCents` (per-currency floor setting). When the invoice currency is short, it buys only the shortfall from `fundingCurrency(db)` (from the CFO policy) on a locked quote. The quote is checked against the market rate and `FX_QUOTE_MAX_MARKUP_BPS`; `QUOTE_SAFETY_MS` applies. The conversion and quote become part of the signed `SupplierPaymentTerms`, and the Purser platform fee is included (`platformPlan`). Executor: `executeSupplierPayment` (src/executors/supplierPayment.ts). Routes come from the pure `chooseRoute`/`validateDetails`/`routeLimitReason` in src/payouts/routes.ts:
- US: USD ACH LOCAL
- GB: GBP Faster Payments, plus a local EUR route
- CN: SWIFT only
- TR: TRY LOCAL
- NL and DE: EUR LOCAL by IBAN
- otherwise SWIFT for the 22 `SWIFT_CURRENCIES` (not JPY: `payableCurrency` requires two decimals).
Batch: `payApInvoices` with `withBatchPlanning`/`reserveForBatch` (src/payouts/planContext.ts, which uses node:async_hooks AsyncLocalStorage). Booking: `paymentEntries` books the conversion through 1590, per currency. Test invoices: test/fakes/fxInvoices.ts (US, CN, UK, TR).

answers.question: 6) e2e world and how it runs
answers.answer:
`WORLD` in src/e2e/world.ts: three fictional Dutch SMEs, each with its own ledger file (`<dir>/<key>/ledger.db`), its own Airwallex connected account, its own signed account binding and its own software test passkey (`FakeAuthenticator`, labelled `TEST_PASSKEY`, not Face ID):
- SANDBOXTEST, 'Purser Sandbox Test (fake sole trader)', acct_SC-QD89fOneAeqaRFgOymw: ZV-5001 from Zeeland Verpakkingen B.V. (test), EUR 4.84, upload.
- BAKKERIJ, 'Bakkerij De Test (fake)', new account: MM-2026-114 from Meelhandel Molenaar, EUR 3.63, by e-mail; VE-889 from Verpakking Express, EUR 2.42, upload. These two are paid as a batch.
- FIETSLAB, 'Fietslab Test (fake)', new account: OD-77 from Onderdelen Direct, EUR 6.05, by e-mail.
All invoices are Dutch text (the `nlInvoice` template: Factuurnummer, BTW 21%, IBAN, BIC), rendered to PDF by `pdfOf` and wrapped by `emlWith` (src/e2e/documents.ts).
Flow (`runPlatformE2E` → `runCompany`): open or activate the account, fund it, store the binding plus a 50 bps fee, enrol the passkey, ingest, verify the supplier and approve it with the passkey, approve the payment or batch, pay x-on-behalf-of with application_fee_options, follow to PAID, `apJournal` → `toPostings` → `pushToT0`, then write a hash-chained receipt (`chainSteps`) and summary.json. It does NOT call `syncLedger` or `syncVault`.
Commands:
- `npm run e2e:live`: a dry run with `FakeAirwallex` (src/redteam/airwallex.ts), `FakeT0`, `FakePlatformOps` and the parser instead of Claude; nothing leaves the machine.
- `E2E_LIVE=yes npm run e2e:live -- --live [--dir ...]`: live, with the call budget `E2E_BUDGET` (default `PHASE2_BUDGET` airwallex=26, t0=12, claude=8) and `T0_RATES`.
Resume: `retryCompany` (src/e2e/retry.ts) and `finishRun` (src/e2e/finish.ts). Live result on 10 Nov (docs/runs/2026-11-10-platform-e2e.md): 1 payout PAID, booked, in T:0 with a verifying receipt; 3 refused by Airwallex for a missing business registration number.
In-process alternative without the network: test/fakes/vaultWorld.ts `vaultWorld()`.

answers.question: 7) Portability: node:* and Node-only deps per module; what runs in a Worker or a DO
answers.answer:
Engine-wide: everything takes `DB` = better-sqlite3 (a native addon), so nothing runs unchanged on D1, whose API is async. A Durable Object's `ctx.storage.sql` is synchronous, so a shim implementing `prepare().get/all/run`, `transaction(fn)` plus `.immediate` (via `transactionSync`) and `run().changes` could carry most of the code. `openDb` itself must be replaced: it uses `pragma journal_mode=WAL`, `Atomics.wait` and node:fs to read the .sql files. Whether DO SQLite accepts the triggers and `PRAGMA table_info` is unverified.
Per module:
- db/open.ts: better-sqlite3, node:fs, node:path.
- ap/inbox.ts: node:crypto (createHash), node:fs (writes docs/<sha>.pdf, readFileSync in `recheck`), node:path.
- ap/pdfText.ts: node:module, node:url, node:worker_threads, node:zlib, unpdf. Hard blocker; it needs a different isolation design in Workers.
- ap/scan.ts: pdfkit (`imageToPdf`).
- ap/books.ts: node:fs and node:path (`CsvFileSink`); `process.env` in `payablesSink`.
- ap/pay.ts and ap/detail.ts: node:fs readFileSync of the stored PDF, then `pdfText`.
- ap/watch.ts: node:fs.
- ap/eml.ts: Buffer only.
- ap/checks.ts, reading.ts, classify.ts, read.ts, review.ts, credits.ts, insights.ts, store.ts, vendors.ts, bank.ts, public.ts: no node imports (zod; `ibanSha` from agents/invoice.ts uses node:crypto).
- batchPay.ts → payouts/planContext.ts: node:async_hooks.
- payouts/plan.ts: node:crypto randomUUID.
- payouts/routes.ts: pure.
- executors: no direct node imports (they depend on airwallex/adapter.ts with node:crypto and on `process.env`).
- ledger/core.ts, documents.ts, close.ts, feed.ts, reports.ts, vat.ts, accounts.ts: no node imports. core.ts uses `jcs` from @metalntwx/metal-pay and `sha256Hex` (lib/terms.ts, node:crypto).
- ledger/page.ts: node:crypto. ledger/serve.ts: express.
- accounting/gl.ts and books.ts: none. accounting/t0.ts: node:crypto.
- vault/layout.ts: pure. vault/data.ts: node:crypto. vault/build.ts: node:fs readFileSync of the original PDF. vault/pdf.ts: pdfkit. vault/sink.ts: node:fs, node:path, node:crypto. gdrive.ts/onedrive.ts: fetch (+ node:crypto randomBytes). vault/page.ts: express, node:fs.

risks: Two booking paths can drift: the CSV `BookkeepingSink` gets payment entries from `paymentEntries`, while the stored ledger gets them from accounting/gl.ts `journal()` via `syncLedger`. T:0 in e2e uses `apJournal`; `npm run t0` uses accounting/books.ts.
The e2e does not exercise `syncLedger` or the vault; only test/fakes/vaultWorld.ts covers the full chain to the archive.
pdfkit in Workers is unverified; vault PDFs and photo-to-PDF (`imageToPdf`) may need a different library for a Worker demo.
`pdfText` (worker_threads isolation against PDF bombs) has no Worker equivalent; dropping it removes a red-team mitigation.
No FX revaluation: P&L and balance sheet are per currency only.
Vault folder names are hard-coded Dutch, which conflicts with an English-only public demo.
pay.ts error text says 'pays EUR only…' while `payableCurrency` accepts every two-decimal SWIFT currency; the wording is stale.
`nextApId` uses COUNT(*)+1 and relies on single-writer transactions; with multiple DO writers that needs care.
No ERP connector has talked to a live ERP; T:0 sandbox only.
Live e2e: Airwallex refused 3 of 4 payouts from newly opened sole-trader accounts (business registration number required).
